benchmark.path_energy_convention: fixed omega along the B.2 path

interpretation: A, B, and C are controlled diagnostics; none is adopted as a replacement stellar background.
B is not a preferred physical profile; it tests the impact of the alternative plotted mu_mu curve only.
C uses the plotted 1 MeV resolution floor as a stress-test envelope, not as a measured continuation.
The reported escape probability includes the B.1 source change of each variant.
No empirical rescaling is applied and no axial-vector output is generated.
title: Full B.1+B.2 profile-input sensitivity in the 12--15 km region

variant_definitions.B_interpretation: diagnostic substitution only; the alternative PDF curve's physical identity/convention is not promoted to the baseline
variant_definitions.C_interpretation: stress-test envelope using the 1 MeV logarithmic-plot resolution floor; not a reconstructed physical continuation
